purpose: Makes every digest in the Task E2-R1 release manifest verifiable on any platform, without altering one byte of it. 118 of its 449 rows were recorded from a Windows working tree where the file was CRLF on disk while git stored LF, so those digests cannot be reproduced from a Linux checkout. Each is declared here with the representation it was taken from and the canonical digest of the same content.

field_semantics.subject_raw_blob_content_sha256: SHA-256 of the blob's content bytes. NOT git's object id, which is sha1('blob ' + length + NUL + content).
field_semantics.git_blob_object_id: Git's own object id for the path at the subject commit. Recorded beside the content digest so the two are never confused.

verification.reads: git cat-file against the subject commit
verification.rule: Every row is classified independently from the repository and the computed classification must equal the declaration: no missing entry, no surplus entry, no duplicate.

entries.why_unreproducible: The working tree mixed CRLF with bare LF at generation, so the recorded digest is of a byte pattern the content alone cannot reconstruct. Canonical content is verified against the committed blob; the legacy digest is preserved, not re-derived.
